items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I think them boys played some music in them days. How did Punch sound then? ... Chris Kelly, Buddy PT, Jack Carey, Kid Punch.

ctx.x: Can you tell us any more about Chris Kelly, how he sounded? I never got to hear him.

Well I tell you, Chris Kelly sounded good. Chris Kelly was a great musician. And, and I'm talking about the blues. Nobody beat him playing blues. I heard he was a good blues player. Yes, and he put that wow wow mute, that stop or whatever you know. Rubber plunger thing. Yeah, plunger. I mean get the wow wow and then, boy I say, you really went over for that. Went over big. Yeah, Chris Kelly was a great musician. Yeah, when I think about this time, Chris Kelly, Buddy PT, Jack Carey, Kid Punch. I think them boys…
I've only heard him in the last few years. Who?
